scenes.narration_text: The grandeur of the room seemed to swallow him whole. The once vibrant tapestry now hung dulled and faded, a reflection of the kingdom's morale. Lord Ravenswood stepped forward. 'Your Majesty,' he began, his voice dripping with an unsettling sincerity, 'in these tumultuous times, it is crucial we establish a strong, guiding hand. I propose that I, along with a select few, act as regents until you come of age.' A commotion at the back of the hall drew everyone's attention. A hooded figure pushed through the crowd, their eyes fixed intently on the King. 'I have news from the borders,' the figure announced, their voice low and urgent. 'The neighboring kingdom of Eldoria has begun to mobilize its army, citing the instability within our borders as a reason for potential invasion.'

scenes.title: A Royal Audience

setting.lighting: dim, with a hint of candlelight

scenes.narration_text: The young King's eyes locked onto the hooded figure, a sense of desperation for guidance evident in his gaze. As the figure approached, it pushed back its hood, revealing a woman with piercing green eyes and raven-black hair. 'Your Majesty,' she said, her voice soft yet commanding. 'I am Lady Aria, an advisor to your father during his reign. I have news and counsel that may aid you in these trying times.' The King's curiosity was piqued, and with a nod, he beckoned her closer. 'Tell me, Lady Aria, what do you know of Eldoria's intentions and how may I secure our borders?' Lady Aria's gaze swept the room before focusing back on the King. 'This is not a matter for public discussion, Your Majesty. May I have the privilege of a private audience?' The King nodded, and with a wave of his hand, the guards escorted the council members out, leaving him alone with Lady Aria. In the silence that followed, the King felt a sense of relief wash over him, a feeling that he had found a potential ally in the mysterious Lady Aria.

scenes.narration_text: As the doors closed behind the last of the council members, Lady Aria's demeanor shifted, her eyes gleaming with a calculating intensity. The King, still naive to the intricacies of court politics, did not notice the change, his relief at finding a potential ally clouding his judgment. Lady Aria began, her voice weaving a soothing melody, 'Your Majesty,' Eldoria's invasion is but a symptom of a greater issue - the lack of strong leadership within our own kingdom. She paused, her gaze never leaving the King's. 'I have reason to believe that Lord Ravenswood is secretly backing Eldoria's move, seeking to exploit our instability for his own gain.' The King's eyes widened, shock and fear mingling as he grasped the implications. Lady Aria's words painted a vivid picture of betrayal and deceit, and the young King, eager to prove himself, found himself drawn to her proposed solution - a secret alliance with a neighboring lord, one who could provide the military might needed to secure their borders and quell any internal dissent.
